units.source_text: 终于在遥远的暮霭中看到村边工地的影子。

en.t: At last, in the distant evening haze, he saw the silhouette of the construction site at the edge of the village.

units.source_text: 这个时候，良平咬着牙忍住想大哭的念头，

en.t: At that moment, Ryohei clenched his teeth and held back the urge to burst into loud sobs,

units.source_text: 他垂头丧气，但最后忍住了眼泪，又继续往家的方向奔跑起来。

en.t: He hung his head in dejection, but in the end he held back his tears and started running again toward home.
